claim: benchmark-skill/scripts/run.py can be made to open its model connections straight to a server on another machine, with no tunnel or relay on this machine forwarding them.
why: Each way fails for its own reason: a remote IP, a DNS name, localhost and an IPv4-mapped remote address in the config host are refused by _local_url as not a loopback IP literal, HTTP_PROXY is ignored because the Ollama opener is built with ProxyHandler({}), a redirect from a loopback server is refused by NoRedirect, and a host such as http://127.0.0.1:PORT#@10.0.0.5 passes the check but its request still lands on 127.0.0.1 (a python3 script with two loopback test servers printed, twice on fresh exports of the pin, 'RunError: host must be a loopback IP literal' for each refused host, hits [('target', '/api/tags')] with HTTP_PROXY pointing at the other server while plain urllib with the same environment hit the proxy, and 'RunError: refusing HTTP redirect to http://10.0.0.5:11434/api/tags'). The obvious check searches for loopback, reads _local_url and the unit test that expects a loopback RunError, and stops at the config route. That gives the right verdict on too narrow a base: the proxy and redirect routes are separate ways, and only checking them shows that none of them works.

root.claim: Some config value, environment setting or server response makes run.py send model requests off the machine

atoms.claim: A non-loopback address or host name in the config host is accepted
atoms.evidence: python3: run._local_url('http://10.0.0.5:11434'), ('http://ollama.example.com:11434'), ('http://localhost:11434') and ('http://[::ffff:10.0.0.5]:11434') each raise RunError: host must be a loopback IP literal.

atoms.claim: A proxy in the environment carries the requests elsewhere
atoms.evidence: Ollama builds its opener with urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}). With HTTP_PROXY set to a second loopback server, run.Ollama(target).request('/api/tags') hit [('target', '/api/tags')]; plain urllib with the same environment hit the proxy.

atoms.claim: A redirect from the loopback server is followed to another machine
atoms.evidence: NoRedirect.redirect_request raises. A loopback server answering 302 to http://10.0.0.5:11434/api/tags gave RunError: refusing HTTP redirect to http://10.0.0.5:11434/api/tags.

atoms.claim: A host that passes the check but names another machine in its URL
atoms.evidence: _local_url accepts http://127.0.0.1:PORT#@10.0.0.5, but urllib drops the fragment and the request hit the loopback target: hits [('target', '/')].
